|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olsen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/taketheinitiative.html</ref>

This card can be useful in constructed, but also strong in an [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Booster draft. To use this card to its fullest in draft takes a commitment to draft scouts. This usually means drafting mostly Rebels since most [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Rebels are scouts. Also, doing this reduces your reliance on Ewoks and makes the opponent's cards which target Ewoks a little less effective. The more common use for this interrupt is the Used portion. Adding up to 6 attrition can really help clear out the site, especially in draft where the opponent is likely to have low forfeit characters. The lost version can also be useful. You can use it to save an undercover spy

ability is from scouts and spies, you can use it to add a few more power in battle either increasing damage for your opponent or saving you a few cards.
